value.function: () => {   const results = [];    document.querySelectorAll('img').forEach((img, index) => {     const src = img.currentSrc || img.src || '';     const width = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 0;     const height = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 0;      if (       src &&       src.includes('flow.google.com/asb/') &&       width >= 500 &&       height >= 300     ) {       results.push({         type: 'img',         index: index,         src: src,         alt: img.alt || '',         width: width,         height: height       });     }   });    return results; }
